# Copilot instructions

Full instructions for coding agents live in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md); the essentials:

- Stack: Python 3.11+, uv, PyTorch (CPU), numpy/scipy/scikit-image, Pydantic v2, ruff (line length 120), pytest.
- Commands: `uv sync --extra llm`, `uv run pytest -q`, `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run wsp all`.
- Weight-space programming paths must not use gradients: edit weights only through
  `wsp.harness.editor.WeightEditor` or the exact algebra in `wsp.geometry.sdf_ops`. Gradient descent is allowed only for
  fitting the "customer" models and for the explicitly labelled baselines.
- Agents touch models only through `wsp.harness.tools.ToolRegistry`; LLM-written code runs only in
  `wsp.harness.sandbox.PythonSandbox` (never `exec` it in-process, never pass secrets in its environment).
- Units: millimetres in public APIs and results; normalised coordinates (`MM_PER_UNIT = 50`) inside networks.
- New `sdf_ops` operations need an exactness test against a numpy reference.
- `results/` is generated by `uv run wsp all` — never hand-edit numbers; keep README tables in sync with
  `results/*/summary.json`. Do not present scripted-agent results as LLM results.
- Claude API code (`src/wsp/agents/llm.py`): official `anthropic` SDK, default model `claude-opus-5-5`, effort via
  `output_config`, no sampling parameters, no forced `tool_choice`, frozen `system`/`tools`, append-only messages.
